{{Quote|We just have the standard two torpedoes in place. That's all we're supposed to have racked in peacetime.''"''<br />''"''This look like peacetime to you?|Nills and Han Solo|<ref name="Choices of One" />}}
'''Nills''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as a crew member of a [[Golan I Space Defense Platform/Legends|Golan I]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Poln Major]].<ref name="Choices of One" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] staged an [[Battle of the Poln system|attack]] on Imperial forces in the [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]], and he sabotaged the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial-II'' class Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']] to send it on a collision course with the Golan I. On the orders of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agent who had infiltrated the space station by posing as an Imperial [[Officer/Legends|officer]], Nills loaded [[Torpedo/Legends|torpedoes]] to fire at the oncoming [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]].<ref name="Choices of One" />
